description.text: Founded in 1903, Central China Normal University is a key comprehensive normal university directly under the Ministry of Education of China and a key "211 Project". The school is located on Guizi Mountain on the shore of Nanhu Lake in Wuhan, Hubei Province, covering an area of more than 2,000 acres. The school has 25 faculties, more than 60 research institutes and research centers, and enrolls 59 undergraduate majors, 184 master's programs and 94 doctoral programs. The school has formed a complete higher education system, providing full-time education as well as adult education. At present, there are nearly 30,000 full-time students, including more than 8,000 graduate students and more than 2,800 international students.

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Program at Central China Normal University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or equivalent or above 2. Applicants must Be in good health
